title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy script-src-elem allows a wildcard source
description: The Content-Security-Policy script-src-elem directive contains a bare wildcard. script-src-elem takes precedence over script-src for script elements, so a policy that looks strict at the script-src level still accepts a script element from any origin.
applicability: HTTPS responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit script-src-elem directive.
risk: Arbitrary script origins are allowed despite an apparently strict script-src; MEDIUM severity because the override defeats the directive reviewers usually read.
